newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet Feb load factor lower at 55.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet Feb load factor lower at 55.7 pct.

text.p: ValuJet Airlines Inc said Tuesday its February load factor was 55.7 percent, down from 58.6 percent a year ago.

The company said it flew 85.8 million revenue passenger miles (RPMs) and 153.9 million available seat miles (ASMs) in of February. Its flight completion rate for the month was 99.3 percent and on-time arrivals within 15 minutes were 74.7 percent.
"We continue to receive positive feedback from the traveling public about our outstanding operational results," said ValuJet President and Chief Executive Joseph Corr.
